notes: Desktop Staff Reports Dashboard load-time hotfix.
Stops the dashboard from automatically loading every raw report table after the summary loads.
Refresh now loads only the fast summary by default, then keeps drill-down tables on demand.
Adds Load Selected Report so staff can load only the tab they are using.
Adds Load All Reports as an explicit action for staff who intentionally need the full package.
Clicking a report tab now loads that tab's report instead of loading unrelated report areas.
Detailed report tables now show an on-demand message until opened or loaded.
Full Report Package export now prompts staff to load all reports first instead of exporting unloaded placeholder sheets.
Keeps the 1.0.107 executive breakdown, youth journey, inferred journey, and data completion reports.
Keeps Java 25 bytecode compatibility so Staff secure local services start correctly on staff computers.
